newsitem.title: USA: Kodak sales rose in March after flat 2 months.
newsitem.headline: Kodak sales rose in March after flat 2 months.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co sales were flat in January and February, but rose five percent in March, Chief Financial Officer Harry Kavetas said on Tuesday.
For the quarter, the company reported revenues of $3.2 billion, down from $3.5 billion in the same period in the prior year.
The strength of the U.S. dollar affected sales by about $90 million, Kavetas said in an interview with Reuters.
Kavetas said he could not say if the dollar will remain strong. However, if it does, the annualized effect on sales would be about $500 million, he said.
((-- Lisa Marie Pane, New York newsdesk 212-859-1713))
